text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Worried about Seiun Sky's recent lack of drive, I decided to confront her, but she bails on me in response.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo is just as worried and accompanies me when I go to speak with her. Once we find Seiun Sky, she tells us that she's sick of racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo is whipped into a rage. How could she be saying this now? Seiun Sky was the one who helped her find her own path with the words, "at your final wrong turn, you'll have found the right path."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo concludes that she misjudged her and leaves. Seiun Sky then tells me she wants some time alone.
